# Student Hub

Peer-powered academic resource platform for university students: share and
download study notes, past papers, and quizzes by subject and department.

## Site map

- [Home](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/): Recent uploads and search entry point
- [Browse resources](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/browse): Search and filter all resources by subject, type, department
- [Resource page](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/resource): Individual resource detail and download (path: /resource/[id])
- [Upload](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/upload): Contribute a resource (account required)
- [Sign in](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/login): Authentication
- [Sign up](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/signup): Create an account
- [Contact](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/contact): Contact form and support
- [Terms of Service](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/terms): Usage terms
- [Privacy Policy](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/privacy): Data handling practices

## Notes for agents

- Machine-readable sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://student-hub-uet.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
- Content is user-contributed; cite the resource title and uploader rather than treating the site as authoritative course material.
- No tracking cookies; analytics are aggregate-only pageview counts.
